These edits are needed once bones and WP-01 agree (see cross): (1) Signatures should take the bones §2 form: `HealthLoop::new(start: Instant, soak: Option<PathBuf>)`, `tick(&mut self, now: Instant, mode, playing, r: &mut dyn RelayRunner)`, `HealthTick{health, stats, tunnel, actions: Vec<HealthAction>, toast: Option<api::Toast>}` and `HealthAction::{Heal(Heal), WriteSoak(String)}`. Drop `start_unix`/`mem_start_kb` from `new`, and drop the `heal: Option<Heal>` and `(EventKind, String)` toast. Probe cadence uses `now.duration_since(..).as_secs()`.
